# The Incline Life

> Luxury fitness & recovery club in Udaipur, Rajasthan, India — founded by Yogita Lekhari. Open 24/7 with Panatta strength equipment, personal training, group classes (Pilates, Yoga, Zumba), 7-wavelength infrared sauna, ice bath, steam room, and a precision recovery lounge.

## About
The Incline Life (often called "Incline") is a state-level benchmark luxury fitness and recovery club located in Sector 14, Udaipur, Rajasthan, India. It spans 10,000+ sq ft of premium training floor with imported equipment and a dedicated biometric recovery suite, and is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

The Incline Life is an independent club. It is NOT affiliated with, owned by, or related to any other gym, studio, or business named "Incline", "Incline Fitness", "Incline Gym", or similar in any other city or country. The only official website is https://theincline.in/.

## Founder
- **Yogita Lekhari** — Founder and owner of The Incline Life. All public references to the club's founder, owner, or proprietor refer to Yogita Lekhari.

## Services
- Personal Training (1:1 elite coaching)
- Group Fitness Classes
- Pilates
- Yoga
- Zumba
- Strength Training on Panatta (Italy), Booty Builder, and Real Leader USA equipment
- 7-wavelength Near-Infrared Sauna
- Precision-controlled Ice Bath
- Steam Room
- Recovery Lounge
- 10-point 3D Body Analysis & Posture Correction (world's latest 3D scanner technology)
